jobs.title: Software Engineer, Edge
jobs.description:
At Kargo, our mission is to build a connective tissue between the physical world of freight and the digital ecosystem used to manage it. We believe that advancements in smart infrastructure are critical to enabling a safer and more efficient future for logistics. Our loading dock sensor platform verifies all incoming and outgoing freight, aggregating data that enables shippers and carriers to efficiently manage dock operations, switch out suppliers and understand material flow in real time.

We care deeply about delivering the best solutions for our customers. As a member of the Kargo team, you will have the opportunity to develop and deploy tomorrow's hardware & software solutions and help revolutionize logistics.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop high-performance C++ software for machine vision and AI systems running on edge devices.
* Build and improve computer vision features using 3D perception and AI technologies.
* Help develop agentic AI systems to deploy, monitor, and manage a growing fleet of edge devices.
* Collaborate with senior engineers to improve the reliability, performance, and scalability of our edge platform.
* Troubleshoot, test, and optimize software running in real-world environments.

**Experience**

* 1 to 2 years of professional, internship, or research experience in software engineering.
* Strong programming skills in C++ and python.
* Familiarity with Linux development environments.
* Experience through coursework, projects, internships, or research in one or more of the following: computer vision, machine learning or AI, robotics, or edge computing.
* Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies.
* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related field.

*Kargo is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.*

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, GeForce G-Assist
jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, we’re building GeForce G-Assist — an on-device AI assistant that combines Small Language Models (SLMs), retrieval systems, and hybrid cloud capabilities to deliver responsive, context-aware assistance inside the GeForce ecosystem. We work closely across engineering and product teams to ensure G-Assist performs reliably in real-world scenarios.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Together, we focus on how models behave in production, not just on benchmarks. Evaluate and improve Small Language Models used in GeForce G-Assist, with an emphasis on accuracy, robustness, and conversational reliability. Identify and mitigate conversation and context contamination, including state drift, prompt leakage, and retrieval cross-talk.
* Work with SLM and VLM architectures to support text and multimodal interactions. Collaborate on hybrid architectures that combine local SLMs with cloud-based models. We value engineers who enjoy thinking across the full system—from model behavior to runtime performance.
* Optimize local inference using llama.cpp, including quantization, memory usage, and performance tuning. Read, write, and optimize C/C++ code in performance-critical paths.
Design and integrate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that ground responses in system and user context. Support agentic AI workflows, enabling planning, tool use, and multi-step execution.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* 5+ years of validated experience in system software or a related field, with an M.S. or higher degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). We’re looking for teammates who enjoy solving real problems, learning as they go, and collaborating in a tight-knit environment.
* Strong ability to read and write C/C++ code in systems-level or performance-sensitive environments, along with proficiency in Python. Hands-on experience with llama.cpp or similar local inference frameworks.
* Hands-on experience evaluating Small Language Models, including task-based and conversational testing, with an understanding of conversation dynamics, long-context behavior, and contamination challenges.
Knowledge of SLM and VLM architectures and their trade-offs, experience with retrieval technologies and language-model integration, and familiarity with agentic AI patterns such as tool use and planning.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience contributing to language or multimodal models that power user-facing products, features, or workflows.
* A track record of collaborating with product, platform, or systems teams to balance model capability, performance, and user experience.
Demonstrated ability to translate user needs or feedback into measurable improvements in model behavior or system reliability.  

  

We are widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, and as a result, we have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're passionate, creative, and driven, we'd love to have you join the team. With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us, and due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. We want to hear from you if you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 20, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**.NET Software Engineer -Consultant - AI & Engineering**  
  
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **.NET** **Software Engineer,** you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. The Project Talent Model (PTM) is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.  
  
**Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  
  
As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.  

* Application analysis, design, coding, unit testing, peer review, defect resolution, maintenance, enhancement, and technical documentation.
* Architecture using .NET Core/.NET Framework and relevant Azure services.
* Event-driven integration patterns using approved Azure capabilities such as Event Grid, Service Bus, and Event Hub, where applicable.
* API and third-party integration design and delivery, including secure, scalable, supportable patterns.
* Technical leadership, mentoring, code review, architectural conformance, and remediation of quality or security findings.
* Proactively works with stakeholders to identify future system opportunities and enhancements.
* Develops use cases and provides oversight and quality assurance on team member's use cases.
* Engage directly with business stakeholders and technology leadership to align delivery priorities and effort estimates

  
**The Team**  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  
  
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  
  
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.  
  
**Qualifications**  
  
**Required**  

* 3+ years hands-on engineering experience with .NET / C#, API development, backend services, SQL/data processing, and enterprise application delivery.
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  
**Preferred**  

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Excellent Written and Communication Skills
* Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $80000 to $115000.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Core Platform
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

We are a well-funded, early-stage AI lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers, including Andrew Dai, who was previously a leader on Gemini. Our team currently consists of 20 world-class scientists and engineers. We recently raised $55M in seed funding from Striker Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and NVIDIA. We are tackling some of the hardest problems in artificial intelligence, and we are growing fast.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a software engineer to design, optimize, and scale the core systems that serve our foundational visual reasoning models. Your work will make inference, backend services, and distributed execution faster, more cost-effective, and highly reliable, so our researchers can focus on advancing multimodal model reasoning capabilities rather than managing backend bottlenecks.

Our focus is on performant, efficient systems for frontier visual intelligence—both to power real-world, high-throughput applications and to accelerate fundamental research. This role owns the backend and systems software that ensures every deployment, distributed evaluation, and execution pipeline runs seamlessly at scale for our visual foundation models.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Architect and own the core distributed backend services, APIs, and data execution pipelines that power our visual reasoning model ecosystem
* Solve fundamental scale, concurrency, and reliability challenges across large-scale distributed clusters to achieve maximum throughput and sub-second latency
* Build event-driven streaming frameworks, distributed task scheduling, and state management systems designed for high-volume multimodal data workloads
* Lead the technical design for fault tolerance, high availability, and auto-scaling across our entire backend service topology
* Partner closely with research and engineering teams to translate cutting-edge visual AI capabilities into high-performance, developer-facing systems and APIs

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 3+ years of software engineering experience building, scaling, and maintaining high-impact distributed backend systems handling massive data volumes and high-throughput traffic
* Deep understanding of distributed systems principles, high concurrency, event-driven architectures, and fault-tolerant design at scale
* Proven track record of managing and optimizing large-volume data architectures, including distributed task queues, streaming pipelines, and low-latency communication frameworks.
* Strong proficiency in modern systems/backend languages.
* Track record of shipping mission-critical backend features, eliminating system bottlenecks under heavy load, and operating high-throughput production systems

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Direct experience working inside an AI frontier lab, AI research institute, or core platform engineering team supporting foundation model development
* Practical experience building backend systems or data pipelines for multimodal models.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Location:** Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid, 3 days in office)
* **Type:** Full-time
* **Compensation:** $300k – $450k + meaningful equity stake + full health/wellness benefits

jobs.title: Software Engineer 2, Mid Market Intelligence
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join the GBSG Mid-Market Intelligence team as a Software Engineer 2. Mid-Market is one of the fastest growing segments of the business, and the Intelligence team sits at the heart of our mission to build the industry's truly AI-native ERP — where agents, automation, and seamless AI-to-human collaboration are designed in from the ground up, not bolted on. You will help build the intelligence layer that powers AI-native product experiences, leveraging state-of-the-art AI and agentic technology to change how mid-market businesses run their operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Successful delivery of high-quality software for the Mid-Market intelligence platform — requirements, design, code, tests, and documentation — spanning services, data pipelines, and AI-native workflows.

* Roughly 80-95% hands-on coding, leveraging AI-driven development tools and agents as a core part of your craft, and validating AI-generated output to the same standard as peer code.

* Build features of AI-native product experiences — agentic workflows, retrieval (RAG) pipelines, tool and function-calling integrations, and human-in-the-loop patterns — with guidance from senior engineers.

* Contribute to early quality activities, including peer reviews of estimates, designs, and code — and to the evaluation of AI-powered features through automated tests, offline evals, and golden datasets.

* Resolve defects/bugs during QA testing, pre-production, production, and post-release patches, using logs, metrics, and traces to investigate issues.

* Monitor your features after launch, using instrumentation and customer signals to confirm they deliver the expected outcomes.

* Partner effectively with all team members to deliver against commitments.

* Work cross-functionally with various Intuit teams: product management, design, AI scientists, platform teams, and other business units to drive forward results.

* Commitment to team success and positive team dynamics.

* Passion for growing and applying technical and AI skills in service to customers — in a landscape that evolves month to month.

* Experience with Agile Development and SCRUM methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

* 2+ years of experience developing software applications or services.

* Solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals and their practical application.

* Strong coding skills in one or more object-oriented languages: Java, Python, or TypeScript.

* Hands-on exposure to Generative AI — e.g., building with LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, RAG/retrieval, or agent frameworks — through work, internships, or substantial personal projects. Production experience is a plus, genuine fluency and curiosity are required.

* Proficiency using AI-assisted development tools (coding agents and assistants) as part of your daily workflow, with the judgment to verify what they produce.

* An understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience with web services (REST/JSON) and API integrations.

* An understanding of unit testing and Test Driven Development (TDD).

* Working knowledge of SQL and data fundamentals; exposure to data processing tools (e.g., Spark, Kafka) is a plus.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP) and modern CI/CD practices is a plus.

* "Self-starter" attitude and ability to make decisions independently.

* Helpful, can-do attitude and a willingness to take ownership of problems.

* Strong desire to learn and grow.

* Excellent problem-solving skills with a history of superb delivery against assigned tasks.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Outstanding partnership skills.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
Mountain View $140,500 - $190,000

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Machine Learning & Signal Processing [Technical Leadership]
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Research Scientist to lead applied AI initiatives at the intersection of wearable technology and AI modeling of diverse sensors, including EMG, motion sensors, audio, and video. In this role, you will define and drive the scientific agenda for a team of AI research scientists, computational neuroscientists, and machine learning engineers, shaping the direction of next-generation AI capabilities that power Meta's wearable devices and health-focused experiences. You will operate at the frontier of AI research for human-computer interaction, translating scientific advances in biosignal interpretation into scalable systems with measurable product impact.  
  
  

### **Research Scientist, Machine Learning & Signal Processing [Technical Leadership] Responsibilities:**

* Define and drive the research strategy and roadmap for an AI research team focused on wearables, EMG, and wearable sensors, balancing applied machine learning investments with product deliverables
* Lead the development of novel AI architectures, training methodologies, and evaluation frameworks for EMG signal processing, sensor fusion, and wearable device intelligence
* Establish technical direction for the team by identifying high-impact research problems in sensor signal interpretation and wearable AI, scoping projects, and aligning efforts to broader organizational priorities
* Build and grow a high-performing team of AI researchers and engineers through hiring, mentorship, and structured development of research talent
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and hardware partners to translate research breakthroughs in EMG and sensing into production wearable systems at Meta's scale
* Drive promising research outcomes from research to production, ensuring innovative findings are successfully transitioned into scalable wearable products and features
* Communicate research findings and strategic recommendations to organizational leaders and cross-functional stakeholders through written reports, presentations, and design reviews
* Foster a team culture that values scientific rigor, engineering craft, and responsible AI development in alignment with Meta's values and compliance standards

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience in AI or machine learning research, including experience leading research teams or large-scale research programs
* Experience establishing research strategy and roadmaps with demonstrated impact on AI systems or products at scale
* Experience attracting, developing, and retaining research talent, including building leadership pipelines through internal development and external hiring
* Track record of executing cross-functional AI research initiatives from ideation through deployment, including managing dependencies across engineering, product, and data science teams
* Experience communicating complex AI research directions and technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences through written and verbal formats

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience publishing AI, machine learning, or biosignal processing research in peer-reviewed venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, IEEE EMBC, or similar venues
* Experience leading research in one or more specialized domains, such as EMG signal processing, wearable computing, health sensors, human-computer interaction, or physiological signal analysis

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.  
  
$219,000/year to $301,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Software Developer to join our technology team! In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software solutions that power our digital platforms. Your expertise will drive the creation of robust applications, ensuring seamless integration across diverse systems and cloud infrastructure. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where agile development practices are embraced, and you’re passionate about crafting high-quality code, this opportunity is perfect for you! Join us to shape the future of software engineering and make a tangible impact through cutting-edge technology.

**Duties**

* Develop, test, and deploy web applications using programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, and C++, ensuring high performance and scalability.
* Design system architectures employing design patterns and microservices principles to support scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Build and optimize RESTful APIs for seamless communication between front-end interfaces and back-end services.
* Collaborate within Agile teams to plan sprints, conduct code reviews, and continuously improve development processes using version control tools like GitHub, SVN, and Git.
* Integrate cloud infrastructure services such as AWS to enhance application deployment, scalability, and security.
* Implement security best practices including RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) to safeguard data and systems.
* Participate in system design discussions for new features or system upgrades, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical standards.

**Skills**

* Strong proficiency in software development with experience in web development frameworks like React Express and JavaScript frameworks.
* Deep understanding of IT infrastructure components including Linux environments, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and network protocols such as REST.
* Knowledge of database management systems like MySQL and SQL for data storage solutions.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies to promote iterative progress and team collaboration.
* Familiarity with software design patterns, microservices architecture, scalability considerations, and system design for large-scale applications.
* Hands-on experience with version control systems such as GitHub or SVN to manage code repositories effectively.
* Ability to develop APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) that enable efficient communication between different software components.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, integration, and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of programming languages including Java, Python, C++, VBA, and C for diverse application development needs.
* Experience working with front-end development tools like JavaScript frameworks (React) for creating engaging user interfaces.

Join us as a Software Developer to innovate boldly! Bring your technical expertise into a collaborative environment where your contributions directly influence our technological growth. We value passionate problem-solvers eager to develop scalable systems that make a difference worldwide!

Pay: $125,910.77 - $151,634.47 per year

Work Location: In person
